en: A vintage multi‑view postcard with three black‑and‑white photographs framed by decorative floral and scroll motifs. The scenes show straight streets in a small town with late‑19th/early‑20th‑century European houses, shuttered windows, and steep tiled roofs, with low hills in the background. People in period clothing stand or walk along unpaved or roughly paved roads. One corner of the card is folded over, obscuring part of the design and some faint reverse‑side writing.
